title: Lacatski's warning that Yankee Blue was a psyop

tellings.quote: saying um Yankee Blue. That was a That was a psyop.

plain: James Lacatski, a defense intelligence official who once ran a government-funded UFO study, is said to have warned that a supposed secret programme called Yankee Blue "was a psyop," meaning a deliberate psychological operation to mislead people. Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who covers UFOs, relays this to Michels and also names George Knapp, a Las Vegas investigative journalist, in connection with the warning. If true, at least one name passed around as a real hidden programme would be a planted story.
